name: Abyssal Barometer Ridge
core_rationale: Northern barometer-beacon ridge of Nebula Undertide at [1, 0] where mercury-filled crystal columns regulate the Violet Squall airship corridor back toward Hearthbloom Basin.

South.lock_message: Inverted tidal pressure along the Abyssal Barometer Ridge crushes uncalibrated diving bells; the Undertide Bell-Keepers require the Cradle Star-Heart before unsealing the northern coral lock.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bell-Keepers say that when all three crystal barometers on the northern ridge turn gold, the Violet Squall parts to reveal Hearthbloom Sky-Spire.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Three towering crystal barometer tubes glowing violet above a ridge of inverted black coral.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Who extinguished the Violet Squall barometer beacons during the final night of the Clockspring War?

causal_continuity.evidence: Links Nebula Undertide's northern coral lock to the Violet Squall airship beacons referenced in Continent 03 travel_links.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Towering crystal barometer tubes glowing violet above a ridge of inverted black coral.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: barometer catwalk and coral step metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved at [1, 0] north of Undertide Sanctuary behind a fog_of_lore portal.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null, fog_of_lore portal symmetry with town-undertide-sanctuary, and complete mystery_hook.
